text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Excessive topical use of tazarotene cream, 0.1% may lead to marked redness, peeling, or discomfort [see Warnings and Precautions (5.2)] . Tazarotene cream, 0.1% is not for oral use. Oral ingestion of the drug may lead to the same adverse effects as those associated with excessive oral intake of Vitamin A (hypervitaminosis A) or other retinoids. If oral ingestion occurs, the patient should be monitored, and appropriate supportive measures should be administered as necessary.
